_note: Garage stations. All exist from day one, labelled; buying the kit opens one. Recipes are what the station can make. The hands-on minigames come in step 3; until then 'Make' is instant and marked as a placeholder.

hacking.name: HACKING
hacking.blurb: Solder, flash, build gadgets. Repair neighbours' electronics for cash.

gunsmith.name: GUNSMITH
gunsmith.blurb: Clean, repair, finish parts, build rifles. Reload ammunition.

medical.name: MEDICAL
medical.blurb: Patch up your people. Later: field kits.

printing.name: PRINTING
printing.blurb: Flyers and papers without the citizen serial.

data_siphon.name: Data siphon (USB)
data_siphon.desc: Plug into any PC you can touch for ten seconds. Takes everything.

badge_cloner.name: Badge cloner
badge_cloner.desc: Copy an access badge when you get close (bus, queue, lift).

keypad_reader.name: Keypad reader
keypad_reader.desc: Read a door code from the warmth left on the keys.

rogue_hotspot.name: Rogue hotspot
rogue_hotspot.desc: Sit in a cafe. Catch what connects.

multitool.name: Pocket multitool
multitool.desc: Gates, garage doors, cheap badges, remotes.

car_relay.name: Car relay
car_relay.desc: Open and start a car whose key is in the owner's pocket.

radio_scanner.name: Radio scanner
radio_scanner.desc: Hear the precinct. Warning before raids.

repair_job.name: Repair a neighbour's device
repair_job.desc: Fix it, get paid. Practice that pays.

finish_receiver.name: Finish a receiver
finish_receiver.desc: Drill to the line, file to fit.

room_bug.name: Room bug
room_bug.desc: Hide it in a room. Listen later.

gps_tracker.name: GPS tracker
gps_tracker.desc: Under a bumper. Know where they go.

forged_badge.name: Forged staff badge
forged_badge.desc: Copy a real one. The details matter.

field_kit.name: Field first aid kit
field_kit.desc: Keeps one of your people alive one more minute.

flyers.name: A stack of flyers
flyers.desc: Paper the town. No serial dots.
